description: An optional plugin instance fails validate/register/ready. Host must continue booting other plugins, mark this instance degraded, and surface it in catalog/health/readiness — never catch-and-ignore silently.
notes: 051 plan section 9: 'optional 插件只有在 manifest 已定義隔離邊界與 degraded behavior 時才能停用後繼續，並必須讓 readiness、catalog 與 alert 明確呈現 degraded'. Instance-qualified catalog key matches PL0-03 multi-instance namespace rule.
